panels.title: 💰 Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR)
panels.description: Total monthly revenue generated from active SaaS subscriptions. Plain English: Monthly income from paying clients.

panels.title: 📅 Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR)
panels.description: Annualized revenue projection based on current active subscriptions. Plain English: Expected annual recurring sales.

panels.title: 🏢 Active Customer Tenants
panels.description: Count of customer organization databases currently active. Plain English: Number of active company accounts.

panels.title: 👥 Total Managed Employees
panels.description: Aggregate active workforce records managed across all client accounts. Plain English: Total employee seats in use.

panels.title: ⏰ Daily Attendance & Clock In / Out Activity
panels.description: Real-time employee clock-in and check-out logs processed today. Technical metric: micrometer gauge hr_attendance_today.

panels.title: 💳 Payroll Execution & Failure Monitoring
panels.description: Tracks successful payroll disbursements versus any failed runs requiring HR or Engineering attention.
